There are two ways of working through the AdaptedMind curriculum.
1. Choose a specific skill you want to work on.
After logging in, click the "Practice" tab. To choose a specific skill, click "Lessons by grade" in the left menu. Choose the grade level of the skill. Select the desired skill.
2. Let us choose the skills to maximize the student's learning
After logging in, click the "Practice" tab. To use this option, click "Smart Practice" in the left menu.
The first time you use this feature, we'll give the student a quick pre-test. This helps us pick the best starting place in the curriculum based on what he or she already knows.
How do I choose a lesson for online practice? What's Smart Practice?
After logging in, click the "Practice" tab from the left menu. Then, click the desired grade from the left menu.
Clicking on the grade will change the account settings for the student. The "Smart Practice" feature, "Progress", and "Badges" will all now be set to the new grade.
How do I change the grade level?

After logging in, navigate to the Math subject, and then select a grade from the menu. Next, click on the 'Progress Report' button in the top right corner. Select the “Worksheets” link for the desired lesson.
Each lesson has 10 worksheets. Scroll down to access links to additional worksheets. To print a worksheet, click the “Print This Worksheet” link in the left corner of the page.

The minimum system requirements to run the app on your phone are as follows:

For iOS devices: iOS 15 and up. This requirement is set to ensure that the app runs smoothly on Apple devices, taking advantage of the latest system improvements and APIs available from iOS 15 onwards.
For Android devices: Android 7 (API level 24) and up. This ensures compatibility with recent security updates and app features designed for newer versions of Android.

Please check your device's operating system version to ensure it meets these requirements before downloading or updating the app. If your device is running an older version, you may need to update your operating system to use the app.
